# AutoLeadss

> A done-for-you growth agency for businesses in the UAE, the wider Gulf, and Egypt. One package covers a website build or redesign, an AI chatbot, weekly ad management with ad spend included, and social media content.

AutoLeadss is an agency, not a software product. There is no signup, no login and no self-serve plan — the work is done for the client by the team.

## The package

One package at **$1,500 per month**, which includes:

- **A website, built or redesigned** — hosted and kept current, not handed over and abandoned.
- **An AI chatbot** answering customer enquiries 24/7.
- **A new ad campaign every week**, managed end to end. **$500 of the $1,500 is ad spend** paid directly to the platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok) on the client's own ad accounts — so the management fee is effectively $1,000 and the media budget is already funded.
- **3 social posts a week** in whatever format the post calls for: UGC-style video, product and service showcases, informative and educational posts, AI avatar presenters, offers and announcements.

No setup fee and no long contract. New clients start with a **free 30-minute consultation call** — a review of their current site, ads and social, with no card required and no obligation to buy.

Work is produced natively in **both Arabic and English**. Clients own their ad accounts, creative and data.

Typical clients: real estate, e-commerce, clinics, and service businesses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Cairo and Alexandria.
